description: The chart illustrates average joint goal accuracy (Avg. JGA) scores across dialogue turns, comparing two model variants shown as paired bars for each turn ID. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled “Turn ID,” shown at even-numbered positions from 0 through 26 in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled “Avg. JGA Score” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.2 up to 1.0, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. For each turn ID, there are two adjacent vertical bars: an orange bar (the first series, labeled in the legend but partially obscured) and a yellow bar labeled “T5-small.” At Turn ID 0, the orange bar is just under 1.0 (about 0.96) and the yellow bar is slightly lower (about 0.95); at Turn ID 2, the orange bar is about 0.92 and the yellow bar about 0.84; at Turn ID 4, the orange bar is about 0.88 and the yellow bar about 0.71; at Turn ID 6, the orange bar is about 0.83 and the yellow bar about 0.61; at Turn ID 8, the orange bar is about 0.77 and the yellow bar about 0.59; at Turn ID 10, the orange bar is about 0.75 and the yellow bar about 0.51; at Turn ID 12, the orange bar is about 0.73 and the yellow bar about 0.46; at Turn ID 14, the orange bar is about 0.69 and the yellow bar about 0.48; at Turn ID 16, the orange bar is about 0.67 and the yellow bar about 0.47; at Turn ID 18, the orange bar is about 0.61 and the yellow bar about 0.48; at Turn ID 20, the orange bar is about 0.65 and the yellow bar about 0.43; at Turn ID 22, the orange bar is about 0.60 and the yellow bar about 0.42; at Turn ID 24, the orange bar is about 0.64 and the yellow bar about 0.30; and at Turn ID 26, the orange bar is about 0.44 and the yellow bar about 0.33. The bars are grouped by turn (side-by-side pairs) rather than stacked, and there are no visible annotations on individual bars; the ordering follows the increasing Turn ID sequence rather than sorting by bar height.
